title: Paul's Foundry Module
description: Fight and session stats with a dashboard, Roll of Valour journal and chat history import, party and character shortcuts, a grip toggle for Crucible's Versatile weapons, real token light for Crucible's Reveal spell, a Wound Medical Kit to use after a Rest, an addictive Madness tonic, and per-player movement confirmation. Works with any system; the stats, grip toggle, Reveal light and items are made for Crucible.
